results.name: toolz-sliding-window
results.summary: Fixed sliding_window by changing the islice argument from i+1 to i in toolz/itertoolz.py line 670. This makes sliding_window(2, [1,2,3,4]) produce [(1,2),(2,3),(3,4)] as expected. Verified by running the sliding_window tests which now pass.

results.name: more-itertools-tail
results.summary: Fixed the tail function in more_itertools/recipes.py by ensuring the start index for islice is non-negative. Changed `islice(iterable, size - n, None)` to `islice(iterable, max(0, size - n), None)`. This prevents ValueError when the requested tail size exceeds the iterable length. All tests pass.

results.name: humanize-naturalsize
results.summary: Fixed the naturalsize function to use base 1000 for decimal mode (default) and base 1024 for binary and gnu modes. This corrects the output for values like naturalsize(3000000) to return '3.0 MB' as expected. All tests pass.

results.name: jmespath-prefix-suffix
results.summary: Fixed the ends_with and starts_with functions in jmespath/functions.py which were incorrectly implemented (they were swapped).
